'''February 2005 Ambler tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament held on Saturday 5 February 2005 at the Church of Acts, 6 S. Main St., 2nd Floor, Ambler, Pennsylvania, with [[Michael Phelps]] as tournament director. It was one of the regular tournaments held there on the first Saturday of each month.<ref name="pcf-3153-60270">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60270#60270 Regular SWCCG Tourny in the Philly area!], Michael Phelps, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015439/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60270%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Church of Acts, 6 S. Main St., 2nd Floor, Ambler, Pennsylvania<ref name="pcf-3153-60270" />
* '''Dates:''' 5 February 2005, 11:00 AM<ref name="pcf-3153-60270" /><ref name="pcf-3153-61396">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=61396#61396 Regular SWCCG Tourny in the Philly area!], Michael Phelps, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015439/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60270%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Michael Phelps]]<ref name="pcf-3153-60270" />
* '''Structure:''' Swiss, constructed, unlimited card pool; four rounds<ref name="pcf-3153-60270" /><ref name="pcf-3153-61396" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $2.00 admission; lunch $2.50 (optional)<ref name="pcf-3153-60270" />

Because of a tight schedule, Phelps started the tournament at 11:00 AM and limited it to four rounds instead of six.<ref name="pcf-3153-61396" /> After the tournament he was to draw one of six cards at random: [[2X-7KPR]], [[Endor: Forest Clearing]] and [[4-LOM]] for the Dark Side, and [[Patrol Craft]], [[2X-3KPR]] and [[Bravo Fighter]] for the Light Side. Players who had included the drawn card in one of their decks would receive a non-foil [[Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber|Qui-Gon With Lightsaber]] or a non-unique [[Destroyer Droid]].<ref name="pcf-3153-61396" />
